acceptanceCriteria.criterion: MCP tool defined: "get_financial_insights" with optional filter parameters (category, time period). Validation: Unit test - tool registered with FastMCP, accepts InsightsQueryRequest.
Tool returns ranked list of insights with supporting data. Validation: Unit test - response includes List[Insight] with priority ranking and supporting_data dict.
Default query returns top 3-5 most important insights. Validation: Unit test - default limit=5, results sorted by priority ascending (1=highest).
Insights formatted for conversational display. Validation: Unit test - response includes formatted_summary string suitable for LLM response.
User testing validates insight relevance and usefulness. Validation: Integration test - test queries return relevant insights matching query context.
